user.title: Garmin watch over BLE
user.description:
Home Assistant advertises a Bluetooth service on this adapter.

Entities with the label below are exposed to approved watches.

To add a watch, open the HassControl BLE app on it. It pairs, then shows up here for approval.

approve.title: Allow Garmin watch {address}?
approve.description:
Code: **{code}**

Allow only if your watch showed the same code. The watch can then control the entities you exposed.

Unanswered requests expire after 24 hours.

abort.not_pending: This watch is no longer waiting for approval.
